concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-gift-cards-stored-value-api-issue]] — 2023-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Stored Value API /issue guide for virtual card creation, provider/channel conditions, new-versus-existing SVS restriction and inconsistent sample response.
warnings: New Stored Value API integrations cannot issue SVS gift cards; existing integrations that have issued them can continue.
Sample response is labeled SVS but its paymentMethod.type is givex; do not infer provider-specific behavior from it.
Online Givex/Fiserv matrix checks do not establish merchant-specific onboarding or live card issuance.
